firm_data.firm_description: Hamilton Clarke is an elite boutique law firm that represents clients in high-stakes Corporate and Shareholder Activism, Commercial and Civil Litigation, and White Collar and Criminal Defense matters. HC brings sophistication, experience, and relentlessness to each matter.
notable_facts: Clients include Fortune 500 companies, technology companies, startups, leading hedge and private funds, c-suite executives, board of directors and special committees, and high profile celebrities, politicians and professional athletes.
The firm was founded by attorneys from The Bronx Defenders and The Legal Aid Society of New York.
